questions.prompt: The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896 is notable for what?

questions.prompt: Which planet has the largest volcano in the solar system?

questions.prompt: Which country won the men's football World Cup in 1966?

questions.prompt: Which TV format features contestants in a house under constant filming?
questions.fact: It began in the Netherlands in 1999 and takes its name from the surveillance state in Orwell's novel.

questions.prompt: Which sea is bordered by Vietnam, the Philippines and China?
questions.fact: Roughly a third of global shipping passes through it, which is much of why its islands are so fiercely contested.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Half of a Yellow Sun?
questions.fact: The title refers to the emblem on the flag of Biafra, the breakaway state at the centre of the story.
